description: Prompt for Copilot CLI to fix the problems of one ESLint rule. Lines are joined with a space. {ruleId} is replaced by the rule and {messageFile} by the file for the commit message. Keep it free of double quotes and shell characters (single quotes are fine): it is passed through a shell inside double quotes.
lines: Fix only the ESLint problems of the rule {ruleId} in this project.
Check them with: npx uselab-linting check '{ruleId}'. This is the check command. Keep the single quotes around the rule name, because PowerShell cannot parse an unquoted name that starts with @.
Do not change code for other rules.

Fix the root cause. Do not take shortcuts: do not disable the rule, do not add eslint-disable comments, do not change the ESLint config or ignores, do not use ts-ignore, any or type assertions to silence it.
Run the check command again after your changes until it reports no problems.
If you have difficulty fixing a problem, ask me for permission before commenting it out; never do that without my explicit permission.
When the check command reports no problems, write a one-line commit message that describes the fix to the file {messageFile}, then tell me to type /exit to return.
